name: Local solar time of an overpass
equation_v2: t_{\mathrm{LMST}} = \left(t_{\mathrm{UTC}} + \frac{\lambda}{15}\right) \bmod 24,\qquad t_{\mathrm{LAST}} = t_{\mathrm{LMST}} + \frac{E(d)}{60}
audit_finding: Equation correct. Added modulo-24 and the equation-of-time note. Local solar time is not IST: Ludhiana (75.85°E) solar noon is ~12:06 LMST while IST is fixed to 82.5°E.
ui_surface: Explorer overpass card, Blind Spot clock, Sensor Lab day/night split.

name: Pixel growth with scan angle
equation_v2: A_{\mathrm{pix}} = \mathrm{scan}\times\mathrm{track}\ \ (\text{use FIRMS columns, km}^2),\qquad \text{flat-Earth } 1/\cos^2\theta \text{ is a teaching approximation only}
audit_finding: The 1/cos² law is a flat-Earth approximation and underestimates MODIS edge growth. FIRMS already supplies scan and track, so use them. A bigger pixel does not mean a bigger fire.
ui_surface: Sensor Lab: 'why the dots differ' panel; Learn lesson 2.

name: Grid cell index
equation_v2: i = \min\!\left(\left\lfloor \mathrm{round}_9\!\frac{\varphi+90}{\Delta}\right\rfloor, \tfrac{180}{\Delta}-1\right),\quad j = \min\!\left(\left\lfloor \mathrm{round}_9\!\frac{\mathrm{wrap}(\lambda)+180}{\Delta}\right\rfloor, \tfrac{360}{\Delta}-1\right)
audit_finding: RUN here: plain floor misassigns 643 of 1,800 latitude edges and 1,287 of 3,600 longitude edges at 0.1° because of binary floating point (e.g. 28.1°N → row 1180 instead of 1181). Also λ = 180 produces column 3600, outside 0–3599.
ui_surface: Explorer cell id chip; Studio grid slider.

name: Area of a grid cell on the sphere
equation_v2: A = R^2\,\Delta\lambda\,(\sin\varphi_2 - \sin\varphi_1),\ \ R = 6371.0088\ \mathrm{km};\quad A_{\mathrm{region}} = \sum_g f_g A_g
audit_finding: RUN here on real Natural Earth polygons: gridded areas Punjab 50,444 km², Haryana 43,997 km², Delhi 1,481 km², Mato Grosso 906,656 km², NSW 802,467 km² — close to published state areas (Punjab ≈50,362, Haryana ≈44,212 km²).

name: Fire cell-day indicator
equation_v2: c_{s,g,d,\delta} = \mathbb{1}[\,n_{s,g,d,\delta} \ge 1\,]\ \text{ (per platform } s\text{, local day } d\text{, day/night } \delta)
audit_finding: v1 deduplicates by (cell, date, sensor) and loses platform and day/night. Keep platform and δ so day/night calibration (F13) and coverage (F09) are possible.

name: Monthly cell-day count
equation_v2: C_{s,r,m} = \sum_{g \in r} \sum_{d \in m} c_{s,g,d},\ \ \text{value} = \text{NULL if } E_{s,r,m}\ \text{unknown}
audit_finding: v1 monthly_counts groups by sensor×year×month only, with no region/cell key; the calendar builder then fills absent months with 0. Absent = unknown, not zero.
ui_surface: Calendar raw mode; Explorer time strip.

name: Equal-confidence filter
equation_v2: \mathrm{keep}_i = \mathbb{1}[\,\mathrm{class}_i \in \mathcal{Q}_s\,],\ \ \mathcal{Q}\ \text{chosen from a sensitivity grid}\ \{\text{MODIS}\ge 0,30,50,80\}\times\{\text{l,n,h};\ \text{n,h};\ \text{h}\}
audit_finding: v1 maps VIIRS l/n/h to 0.25/0.6/0.9 and UI says 'same confidence 0.6 both sensors'. These numbers are labels, not calibrated probabilities. Keep categories; report results for several filter pairs and pick by held-out agreement.
ui_surface: Explorer confidence control becomes a named rule picker.

name: Persistence (static-source mask)
equation_v2: p_g = \frac{\sum_d c_{g,d}}{\sum_d \mathbb{1}[\text{valid}_{g,d}]},\quad p_g = \text{NULL if denominator}=0
audit_finding: RUN here: v1 persistence(0, 0) returns 0.0 (no activity) instead of unknown. Denominator should be observed days, not calendar days.
code_hook_v2: p = active / observed if observed > 0 else None

name: Clear-sky (exposure) fire rate
equation_v2: r_{s,g,m} = \frac{F_{s,g,m}}{E_{s,g,m}},\ \ E = \#\{\text{days with FireMask}\in\{3,5,7,8,9\}\},\ \ r = \text{NULL if } E=0
audit_finding: Correct at K=0 → None (v1 test). v2 makes E platform-specific, defines which FireMask classes count (6 'unknown' is not clear), and stores E alongside every rate.
code_hook_v2: E = count(FireMask in {3,5,7,8,9}); r = F/E if E > 0 else None

name: Monthly overlap ratio
equation_v2: k_{r,\sigma,y} = \frac{V_{r,\sigma,y}}{M_{r,\sigma,y}}\ \ \text{only for strata }\sigma=(\text{month},\delta,\text{platform pair})\text{ with both sensors observing}
audit_finding: v1 silently drops months with M=0 (a VIIRS=9 month vanished in the test) and treats all post-2012 years as one pool. Pair real overlapping periods and platforms (Aqua↔S-NPP afternoon; Terra has no VIIRS partner).
code_hook_v2: pairs = join(modis, viirs, on=[cell, date, dn]); ratio per stratum
ui_surface: Sensor Lab bar chart of k by month with n shown.

name: Median of ratios
equation_v2: \hat k_{\mathrm{robust}} = \operatorname{median}\{k_m : M_m \ge 5\}\ \text{ kept as baseline B3a; primary estimator is ratio of totals / GLM (F14)}
audit_finding: RUN here (simulated, true k=2.6, MODIS 0–3 per month): median of monthly ratios averaged 2.22 (biased); ratio of totals 2.72. Median is a useful robustness check, not the default estimator for sparse counts. The ≥5 rule from the visual guide helps but discards data.
code_hook_v2: k_med = median([v/m for v,m in pairs if m >= 5])

name: Harmonised MODIS value
equation_v2: \hat V^{\mathrm{eq}}_{r,\sigma,t} = \hat k_{r,\sigma}\, M_{r,\sigma,t}\ \ \text{(estimate, with interval)};\ \ t\ge 2012:\ V_{r,t}\ \text{observed}
audit_finding: Fine as arithmetic. Visual guide example '200 → 521 with k=2.6' should be 520. Label output as an estimate with an interval and the k version used.
code_hook_v2: H = k * M ; H_lo, H_hi from propagated interval

name: Separate day and night factors
equation_v2: \hat k_{\delta} \text{ per stratum } \delta\in\{D,N\}\ \text{using matched overpass windows (actual acq_time, not fixed 10:30/13:30)}
audit_finding: Use observed acquisition times per year; generic Terra 10:30 / Aqua 13:30 is wrong for late years (NASA: Terra crossing ~10:15 by fall 2022).
code_hook_v2: for dn in ['D','N']: k[dn] = fit(pairs[pairs.dn == dn])

name: Poisson GLM with exposure offset
equation_v2: \log\mu_{s,r,t} = \log E_{s,r,t} + \alpha_r + \gamma_s + x^{\top}\beta,\ \ Y\sim\mathrm{NegBin}(\mu,\theta);\ \ \hat k=e^{\hat\gamma_V-\hat\gamma_M}
audit_finding: RUN here: intercept-only Poisson GLM with offset log M gives exactly ΣV/ΣM (2.6000 = 2.6000). It is the ratio of totals, not a different 'confirmation' of F11. Using MODIS counts as exposure is errors-in-variables and breaks at M=0. v2 uses exposure offsets and a sensor term.
code_hook_v2: glm(Y ~ C(sensor) + C(region) + C(dn), offset=log(E), family=NB)

name: Negative-binomial variance
equation_v2: \operatorname{Var}(Y) = \mu + \frac{\mu^2}{\theta},\ \ \hat\phi_{\mathrm{Pearson}} = \frac{1}{n-p}\sum\frac{(y-\hat\mu)^2}{\hat\mu}\ \text{decides Poisson vs NB}
audit_finding: Correct. Add the decision rule: compute φ̂; NB if φ̂ > 1.5. RUN here on the small example: φ̂ = 0.16 (under-dispersed toy data — real data must decide).

name: Delta-method interval for a ratio
equation_v2: \operatorname{Var}(\log\hat k) \approx \frac{1}{V}+\frac{1}{M}-\frac{2\operatorname{Cov}(V,M)}{VM};\ \ \text{default: paired block bootstrap (F24)}
audit_finding: RUN here: totals 247/95 → k 2.60, 95% [2.05, 3.29] under independence. Correlation narrows the true interval, overdispersion widens it; bootstrap over years captures both. Undefined for V or M = 0.
code_hook_v2: se = sqrt(1/V + 1/M) if V>0 and M>0 else None

name: Shrink local factor toward global
equation_v2: \text{kept only as a teaching / fallback rule; production uses F18 on }\log k
audit_finding: Arithmetic is right (3,4,2,4 → 2.5, RUN). Shrinking on the ratio scale is not the same as partial pooling on log k (F18); do not present both as one method.

name: Empirical Bayes partial pooling of log k
equation_v2: y_r=\log\hat k_r,\ \ s_r^2=\widehat{\operatorname{Var}}(y_r);\ \ \hat\tau^2_{\mathrm{DL}}=\max\!\left(0,\frac{Q-(R-1)}{c}\right);\ \ w_r=\frac{\hat\tau^2}{\hat\tau^2+s_r^2};\ \ R\ge 3
audit_finding: v1 divides by (R−1): undefined for one region; empty groups not guarded. v2 uses DerSimonian–Laird τ² with R ≥ 3 guard and returns None otherwise (RUN here).

name: Power law vs ratio (model choice)
equation_v2: \text{compare } \log\mu = \log E + \beta_0 + b\log(M+0.5)\ \text{vs}\ b=1\ \text{by held-out Poisson/NB deviance (blocked CV by year)}
audit_finding: log(M) is −∞ at zero months; Gaussian RSS on logs is not the count likelihood; in-sample AIC is not predictive accuracy.
code_hook_v2: for fold in year_blocks: fit both; score deviance on fold

name: Detection-probability curve (FRP50)
equation_v2: \operatorname{logit}P(D_M=1\mid F_V)=\beta_0+\beta_1\ln F_V+\beta_2\,\theta+\dots,\ \ \mathrm{FRP}_{50}=e^{-\beta_0/\beta_1}\ (\text{at }\theta=0)
audit_finding: Printed equation is logistic in FRP; uploaded code fits log(FRP). Pick one (log form, because FRP is skewed) and publish FRP50 = exp(−β₀/β₁).

name: Log transform of FRP
equation_v2: y = \ln(1+\mathrm{FRP}/1\,\mathrm{MW})
audit_finding: Correct; units made explicit.

name: Quantile mapping
equation_v2: x' = F_V^{-1}(F_M(x))\ \text{ fitted per stratum on matched overlap; extrapolation beyond training range flagged}
audit_finding: Quantile mapping forces the old era's distribution to look like the new one and can erase real extremes or trends in the tails; never apply to cell-day counts, and flag values outside the training range.

name: Bland–Altman agreement
equation_v2: d_t = \log(a_t+0.5)-\log(b_t+0.5),\ \ a=\text{harmonised MODIS},\ b=\text{observed VIIRS};\ \bar d \pm 1.96\,\mathrm{SD}(d)\ \text{on held-out years}
audit_finding: Fix the sign convention in code, docs and axis label (a − b). Counts are heteroscedastic, so use log scale. Must be done on held-out data, not the fit years.

name: Block bootstrap over years
equation_v2: \mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha} = \left[q_{\alpha/2}(\hat\theta^{*}),\ q_{1-\alpha/2}(\hat\theta^{*})\right],\ \alpha\ \text{explicit},\ \text{resample whole years (or seasons)}
audit_finding: Docs say 95% (2.5–97.5) but Book 3 and the code use 5–95 = 90%. RUN here with {2.45, 2.5, 2.5, 2.6}: 90% [2.450, 2.550] vs 95% [2.450, 2.600]. With 4 years the bootstrap distribution has only a handful of values: report 'too few years'.
code_hook_v2: def boot(v, m, alpha=0.05): ... quantile(alpha/2), quantile(1-alpha/2)
ui_surface: Every band shows its level (90% or 95%) in the legend.

name: Monte Carlo error propagation
equation_v1: H^{(s)} = k^{(s)} M^{(s)},\quad k^{(s)}\sim \mathcal{N}(\hat k,\sigma_k^2),\ M^{(s)}\sim\mathrm{Poisson}(M)
equation_v2: \log k^{(s)}\sim\mathcal{N}(\log\hat k,\ \mathrm{se}^2_{\log k}),\ \ H^{(s)}=k^{(s)}\,M^{(s)},\ \ M^{(s)}\sim\mathrm{NB}(M,\hat\theta)\ \text{(predictive)}
audit_finding: RUN here: with k=2.6, σ=1.5 the normal draws are negative 4.2% of the time. Use log scale. Say whether the band is a confidence interval (for the expected value) or a predictive interval (for a new count).
code_hook_v2: k_s = exp(normal(log k, se, S)); M_s = poisson(M, S); H_s = k_s*M_s

name: Exact Poisson interval (Garwood)
equation_v2: \left[\tfrac12\chi^2_{2n,\,\alpha/2},\ \tfrac12\chi^2_{2(n+1),\,1-\alpha/2}\right],\ \ \text{lower}=0\ \text{when } n=0
audit_finding: RUN here: n=3 → [0.62, 8.77] (doc 0.6–8.8). Add n=0 rule.
code_hook_v2: lo = chi2.ppf(a/2, 2n)/2 if n>0 else 0; hi = chi2.ppf(1-a/2, 2n+2)/2

name: Robust anomaly z-score
equation_v2: y_{t}=\log\frac{F_t+0.5}{E_t+1},\ \ z_t=\frac{y_t-\operatorname{med}(y_{\mathcal{B}\setminus t})}{\max(1.4826\,\mathrm{MAD}(y_{\mathcal{B}\setminus t}),\ 0.15)},\ \ |\mathcal{B}|\ge 8
audit_finding: Three versions exist: code uses raw counts with the target year inside the baseline; Atlas uses ln(1+x); visual guide uses ln(rate), which is undefined when rate = 0 (RUN: math domain error). v2 uses the Anscombe-style log((F+0.5)/(E+1)), leave-target-out, ≥8 reference years.
code_hook_v2: ref = [y for yr,y in hist if yr != target]
ui_surface: Calendar 'anomaly z' metric with sample-size badge.

name: Month baseline and spread
equation_v2: \mathrm{base}_{m,-t}=\operatorname{med}_{y\in\mathcal{B}\setminus t}\,y_{y,m},\ \ \mathrm{spread}_{m,-t}=\max(1.4826\,\mathrm{MAD},0.15)\ \text{on the F27 scale}
audit_finding: calendar_build.month_baseline uses raw counts with floor 1.0 and includes the target year. Must use the same scale, floor and leave-out rule as F27.

name: Season start, peak and end (10/90%)
equation_v2: \text{same, on a declared season window } [t_a,t_b]\ \text{(e.g. 15 Sep–31 Dec), weekly bins; NULL if any bin unobserved}
audit_finding: Dates depend on the window and on detection timing; they are dates of detected activity, not ignition dates. Declare the window; null when gaps.

name: Mann–Kendall trend test
equation_v2: \operatorname{Var}(S)=\frac{n(n-1)(2n+5)-\sum_{p} t_p(t_p-1)(2t_p+5)}{18}\ \ (\text{tie groups } t_p)
audit_finding: RUN here: tie correction missing in v1. Series [5,3,6,2,5,4,5,3]: v1 var 65.33 vs corrected 60.67 (pymannkendall agrees, p = 0.700). Counts often tie (zeros), so this matters.
ui_surface: Calendar trend line with p and effect size.

name: Hamed–Rao autocorrelation correction
equation_v2: \text{same, with }\rho_k\text{ of detrended ranks, only significant lags; seasonal Kendall for monthly series}
audit_finding: RUN here on 9 years: z = −1.56, p = 0.118 (no correction applied — lags not significant). With 25 years ρ_k is noisy; report both raw and corrected p.

name: Sen's slope
equation_v2: \beta=\operatorname{median}_{i<j}\frac{x_j-x_i}{t_j-t_i}\ \ (\text{use real year gaps; report \% of baseline and CI})
audit_finding: RUN here: series (b) → −26.4 per year (matches). Use t gaps when years are missing.

name: Pettitt change-point test
equation_v2: \text{same, plus placebo distribution: }K\text{ at random non-sensor years and at 2018/2023 platform additions}
audit_finding: A non-significant Pettitt after harmonisation does not prove the seam is gone (low power with 25 points). Combine with placebo years and the seam ratio interval.

name: PELT multiple change points
equation_v2: \text{Poisson/NB segment cost on monthly exposure rates; penalty } \beta = \text{BIC} \cdot \log n\ \text{declared before running}
audit_finding: Choose cost for counts (not rbf by default); fix penalty before seeing results to avoid tuning to a story.

name: Seam ratio
equation_v2: R_{\mathrm{seam}}=\frac{|\overline{\log H}_{2012\text{–}14}-\overline{\log H}_{2009\text{–}11}|}{|\overline{\log V}_{2012\text{–}14}-\overline{\log M}_{2009\text{–}11}|}\ \text{with bootstrap CI and placebo seams}
audit_finding: One-year-to-one-year comparison mixes real interannual change with the instrument step. Use 3-year windows, log scale, interval, and compare against placebo seams.

name: Held-out error (LOYO and blocked CV)
equation_v2: \mathrm{MAE}_y=|\hat k_{-y}M_y-V_y|,\ \ D_y=2\!\left[V_y\ln\frac{V_y}{\hat\mu_y}-(V_y-\hat\mu_y)\right],\ \ \mathrm{sMAPE}\ \text{with } V_y+\hat\mu_y>0
audit_finding: MAPE is infinite when V = 0 and favours under-prediction. Use MAE + Poisson deviance + guarded sMAPE; also hold out regions.
code_hook_v2: for y in years: k = fit(exclude y); score(y)

name: Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate
equation_v2: \text{same; } m = \text{number of cells actually tested (with enough data)}; \text{BY variant if spatially dependent}
audit_finding: Correct. Define m honestly (cells with data).

name: Kalman fusion (local-level model)
equation_v1: \hat x = \hat x^- + K(z - \hat x^-),\qquad K = \frac{P^-}{P^- + R}
equation_v2: x_t=x_{t-1}+w_t,\ z_{s,t}=x_t+v_{s,t};\ \ P^-_t=P_{t-1}+Q\Delta t,\ K=\frac{P^-}{P^-+R_s};\ \text{skip update when } z\ \text{missing; init on first valid } z
audit_finding: v1 can start with level None when the first values are missing. RUN here with [None, None, 10, 12, None, 11] → [None, None, 10, 11.11, 11.11, 11.05]. Output is a model estimate, never 'observed'.
code_hook_v2: if x is None: init on first valid z

name: Split conformal prediction sets
equation_v2: \text{same; calibration set = held-out sites (GroupKFold by site/region); report coverage by region; abstain if } |C(x)|>1
audit_finding: Guarantee is marginal, not per district. Needs real labelled sites; none exist yet → feature remains PROPOSED.

name: Haversine distance
equation_v2: \text{same, } R=6371.0088\ \mathrm{km};\ \text{for} <1\ \mathrm{km\ precision\ use\ geodesic\ (Karney)}
audit_finding: RUN here: Ludhiana–Amritsar ≈ 124 km (doc 125).

name: DBSCAN fire clustering
equation_v2: \text{ST-DBSCAN on (space, time) with } \varepsilon_s,\varepsilon_t \text{ per sensor resolution; sites from multi-year persistent clusters}
audit_finding: Spatial-only clustering merges unrelated fires on different days; add time. Clusters are not fires 'counted'.

name: Distance-decay exposure (IE / AE)
equation_v2: \mathrm{IE}_g=\sum_f S_f\,e^{-d_{g,f}/L},\ \ L\ \text{fitted on labelled sites};\ \ \text{NULL if OSM coverage unknown}
audit_finding: Two versions exist (smooth exp vs SIH steps 1/0.5/0.2). Pick one; L and weights are hypotheses. Missing OSM must be NULL, not 0.

name: Context log-ratio L
equation_v2: L_g=\ln\frac{\mathrm{IE}_g+1}{\mathrm{AE}_g+1}\ (+=\text{industry});\ \ \text{a feature, not a label}
audit_finding: Sign convention fixed (old deck had it inverted and a wrong 1.46 example; correct ln(6/4) = 0.405, RUN).

name: Night fraction
equation_v2: \nu_g=\frac{N^{N}_g/E^{N}_g}{N^{D}_g/E^{D}_g+N^{N}_g/E^{N}_g}\ \ (\text{exposure-adjusted; night passes are fewer for MODIS})
audit_finding: Raw share is biased by unequal day/night opportunities. Threshold 20% is a hypothesis.

name: Diurnal fraction seen by overpasses
equation_v2: f_{\mathrm{seen}} = \int_{\bigcup_o [t_o-w,\,t_o+w]} g(t)\,dt,\ \ g\ \text{from geostationary/hourly evidence; otherwise labelled SCENARIO}
audit_finding: RUN here: Aqua and NOAA-20 windows overlap near 13:30; summing integrals gives 54.7% instead of the union 36.6% (μ=13, σ=1.5 h). Result is a scenario, not a measured share of fires.

name: Burned-area to detection ratio B
equation_v2: B_{r,y}=\frac{\mathrm{BA}_{r,y}/C_{r,y}}{\operatorname{med}_{y'\in\mathcal{R}}(\mathrm{BA}_{r,y'}/C_{r,y'})},\ \ |\mathcal{R}|\ge3;\ \ \text{PENDING if BA lagged; NULL if } C=0
audit_finding: B is a disagreement flag, never a multiplier ('real burning is 2.4× the dots' is unsupported). Guard zeros, lag (PENDING) and reference-year choice.
ui_surface: Blind Spot B timeline; Brief flag.
